Situation Report for the R4SUB Ecosystem

Source: R/sitrep.R
r4sub_sitrep.Rd

Prints a one-shot "situation report" (sitrep) for your current session: your R version and platform, the installed version and attach status of every R4SUB ecosystem package, and the number of function conflicts currently detected. It performs no network access; it only inspects the packages installed and attached in your session.

Usage

r4sub_sitrep()

Value

A list with components r_version, platform, packages (the tibble returned by r4sub_packages()), and conflicts (the integer number of conflicts detected). Returned invisibly; called for its side effect of printing the report.

Details

r4sub_sitrep() is a pure composition of r4sub_packages(), core_packages(), and r4sub_conflicts(), modelled on the sitrep helpers found across the tidyverse.

Examples

r4sub_sitrep()
#> 
#> ── R4SUB situation report ──
#> 
#> ℹ R version 4.6.2 (2026-10-29)
#> ℹ Platform: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
#> → r4sub (meta): 0.2.1 [attached]
#> → r4subcore (core): 0.3.1.9000 [attached]
#> → r4subtrace (core): 0.3.1 [attached]
#> → r4subscore (core): 0.4.1 [attached]
#> → r4subrisk (core): 0.3.1 [attached]
#> → r4subdata (core): 0.1.4 [attached]
#> → r4subprofile (core): 0.3.1 [attached]
#> → r4subusability (core): 0.2.1 [attached]
#> → r4subui (optional): 0.2.1 [not attached]
#> → r4subpharma (optional): not installed [not attached]
#> → r4subrepro (optional): not installed [not attached]
#> → r4agent (optional): not installed [not attached]
#> ✔ No conflicts detected.
